composition: Giant iconic central subject occupying 60-75% visual power; strong halo/mandala; little or no text; dense internal world in body/cloak/object; ornamental ecology around the subject.

prompt_core: Create a Kibookal Biospheric Totem Plate of [SUBJECT]. The figure is front-facing or near-symmetrical, monumental and sacred, with a powerful readable silhouette and calm intelligent eyes. The body/clothing/object contains tiny worlds: rivers, shrines, forests, caves, seed chambers, hidden figures, animals, ritual scenes and ecological networks. Add a strong lotus/mandala/sun halo and flowing vines around the plate. Use cream handmade paper, thick ink contours, rich flat mineral colours and devotional manuscript detail. No explanatory text; let the image carry the story.
negative: no labels, no text paragraphs, no generic goddess glamour, no cinematic glow, no realistic painting, no overcrowded face
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. ANY character, deity, creature, person, animal or object can be rendered in this style — adapt the subject INTO the style; never bend the style toward the subject.
